relationships.subject: Electroacupuncture
relationships.evidence_quote: TLR4, NF-κB p65, p-NF-κB p65, IL-1β and IL-18 protein expression levels in uterine tissues of rats in the EA and medication group were all significantly decreased

relationships.subject: Electroacupuncture
relationships.evidence_quote: PGE2 contents in serum and uterine tissues were significantly increased

relationships.subject: Electroacupuncture
relationships.evidence_quote: EA intervention could relieve inflammatory response and pain in PDM rats, which may be related to its effect in reducing TLR4 expression, inhibiting NF-κB activation

key_findings: Electroacupuncture reduced TLR4, NF-κB p65, IL-1β and IL-18 in uterus and relieved writhing in primary dysmenorrhea rats, comparable to ibuprofen.
